name: web-pdf
description: Developer-first PDF authoring framework built on @react-pdf/renderer

scripts.build: bun run build:types && bun run build:js
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --external @react-pdf/renderer --external react
scripts.dev: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --external @react-pdf/renderer --external react --watch
